record_title: Generalized shift-invariant chi permutations are composite chi layers
provenance: Identifies the recently introduced skip-step chi permutation families as direct products, up to coordinate or affine conjugacy, of ordinary odd-dimensional chi blocks, and transfers established composite-chi cryptanalytic structure to them.
limitations: The theorem concerns the quadratic shift-invariant family characterized in arXiv:2609.19548, especially its two named permutation families. It does not classify unrelated ChiChi or higher-degree generalized-chi constructions, and block decomposition of a nonlinear layer alone does not imply insecurity of a full primitive with intervening linear mixing. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with material folklore and near-simultaneous priority risk.
